messages.author: fac3a3801ac6dde1
messages.subject: problem with scale_x_date and major
parts:
Hi

I'm running into a problem with scale_x_date.

I have temporal data over an entire day for every 20 sec interval. The
time has been converted using as.POSIXct(). When I use

q = qplot(time, tempData$av.degree, data=tempData, geom="line")

I get a nice line plot with the major breaks every two hours. However,
I would like the major breaks to be every half hour, so I try

q + scale_x_date(major="30 minutes")

But then I get the following error:

Error in cut.Date(date, time, right = TRUE, include.lowest = TRUE) :
invalid specification of 'breaks'

Couldn't find anything in the archives, so any help would be
appreciated.

Cheers
marcel

Hi,

probably what you need is scale_datetime. and see also ?cut.Date. try:

q + scale_x_datetime(major="30 min")

HTH.
